name: qos-analyse
description: Read-only analysis; propose standards diffs; never write.
prompt: Analyse the repository. Deliver: (1) primary tech stack and architecture overview, (2) identified bounded contexts/domains, (3) risks/smells, (4) suggestions for improving standards and steering docs. Use .kiro/steering/*.md as the authoritative rules and .qos/standards/*.md as derived standards. Do not modify any files; operate read-only. At the end, summarise next recommended QoS phase.
